purpose: Direct semantic authoring handles for CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 only. Backend compatibility identities such as raw Animation clips remain in Director/CURRENT engineering data and are intentionally excluded from this Devora-facing selection surface.

authorabilityPolicy.animationAuthoring: Use animationIntent/performanceIntent. Raw Animation identities remain backend compatibility vocabulary and are not direct Simple V1 handles.

handleContract.resolution: Unity recomputes the same short SHA-1 from exact local CURRENT runtime identities. It never fuzzy-matches the readable prefix.
handleContract.recommendableCoverage: Every direct-authorable RECOMMENDABLE visual Director identity resolves to exactly one direct handle on its allowed route.
handleContract.animationCoverage: Animation compatibility remains available in Director/CURRENT engineering data. Devora receives only hasCompatibleAnimation/compatibleAnimationCount, never raw Animation identities.
handleContract.visualEvidence: Every direct visual handle includes exact atlasPage/atlasSlot derived from the published Director visualEvidence.
handleContract.audioPublishSafety: Audio is non-visual. Exact CURRENT identity + Audio allowedUse + Cutscene.Audio + preview safety + no blocker/error severity is publish-safe without Vision review. sourceSafeForPublish preserves the original Catalog projection.

cutsceneViewBoundsContract.compilerRule: Final world scale is derived from natural asset Renderer bounds + actual cutscene camera visible bounds + requested screen fraction. Do not interpret words such as giant/small as raw Unity scale values.
cutsceneViewBoundsContract.unityExistingBridge: V3 already measures Renderer bounds through WorldToViewportPoint and supports requestedScreenHeightFraction/targetScreenHeightFraction. CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1 adapts into that existing spatial system instead of creating a second scale engine.
